description: Turns down background noise (fans, traffic, hum, keyboard) in a recording and keeps the voice, with RNNoise on this machine. Takes any audio or video ffmpeg reads; writes WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC or OGG by the output extension (default <name>-clean.wav), or, for a video, the same video with the cleaned sound when the output is a video file. The sound comes out mono. Needs ffmpeg installed.

amount.description: 1 removes as much as it can (default); lower blends some of the original back

output.description: Default: <name>-clean.wav next to the input; a .mp4/.mov/.mkv/.webm output keeps the video

name: audio_denoise
title: Remove background noise
